name: Church Discipline
overview: Scripture instructs the church to actively address sin and division within its community to maintain doctrinal purity and unity. Believers are called to identify and avoid those who cause divisions or promote false teachings, as seen in Romans 16:17 and Titus 3:10. Restoration is also emphasized, with spiritual members urged to gently restore those overtaken in fault, mindful of their own vulnerability, according to Galatians 6:1 and James 5:19. Church discipline thus balances correction with a spirit of meekness and a goal of repentance.
